## Articles

- [From one chain to one per identity — DEFXN](https://defxn.com/learnings/why-the-chain-was-retired): How DEFXN went from one block chain, through the agreement fabric, to one grammar chain per identity, and which measurements back the current design.
- [One substrate, many networks — DEFXN](https://defxn.com/learnings/one-substrate-many-networks): Learn what named networks isolate today, how the shared substrate differs from a network, and which named examples still need live evidence.
- [Governance without a standing signer set — DEFXN](https://defxn.com/learnings/governance-without-a-validator-set): Explore ephemeral authority cells and the distinction between shared mesh-operations governance and an individual network DAO's roster.
- [How we got fast, and everything we got wrong — DEFXN](https://defxn.com/learnings/how-we-got-fast-and-what-we-got-wrong): The full trail from under 7 transfers a second to about 25,000 across ten machines, including every wrong turn, and what the final number does and does not prove.
- [The grammar does almost no work — DEFXN](https://defxn.com/learnings/the-grammar-does-almost-no-work): What a DEFXN transfer looks like on the wire, why a parser that only knows the dash can still reject bad input, and why the speed comes from somewhere else.
- [A finance resolver by construction — DEFXN](https://defxn.com/learnings/a-resolver-by-construction): See how a finance resolver makes double-spend unrepresentable using one registered letter, a chain per identity, six resolver steps, and a measured 51,065 ops/s result.
- [The chain prototype is the chosen path — DEFXN](https://defxn.com/learnings/the-chain-prototype-is-the-chosen-path): Review the sustained six-node benchmark from the retired chain direction, what that run measured, and the limits on what it establishes.
